description: Customers say they cannot get into or find their account, or that it has been disabled. Others report country or profile-related problems, including unexpected following activity.
code_definition: account hacked, banned, deleted, lost or stuck in the wrong country/profile

description: Customers say they are logged out or unable to log in again, including after changing their password. Some describe difficulty getting into the app or signing in with a mobile number.
code_definition: cannot log in or sign up; password, verification or 'logged out' problems

description: Customers report errors when paying for Premium or student plans, trouble redeeming gift cards, and being unable to access Premium benefits after paying. One customer says they are still owed money.
code_definition: wrong or repeated charges, refunds, payment failures, Premium not activating after paying

description: Customers say basic listening features, such as selecting or skipping songs, are limited or require Premium. Some also say the app prompts them to get Premium or does not work as expected without it.
code_definition: a feature is locked behind Premium or limited on the free tier (choosing a song, skips, rewind, repeat, turning shuffle off), or the app pressures users to buy Premium

issue_name: Subscription Cost and Plan Value Concerns
description: Customers say paid plans, including multi-account plans, can feel too expensive or offer less value than expected. Some say they do not want to subscribe or hope plan prices will not increase.
code_definition: price, price increases, plans, value for money

description: Customers say liked songs and music in their playlists are missing, empty, or no longer visible. Some report that playlists disappear or that their saved music was deleted.
code_definition: praise for how much or what kind of music/podcasts is available ("has every song", "huge selection"); not for "great music" in general

description: Customers say lyrics are missing or do not appear for some or all songs, sometimes failing to load. Some also report that lyrics are incorrect or that the lyrics font is difficult to read.
code_definition: lyrics missing, wrong or unavailable

description: Customers say songs, including Bollywood tracks and favorites, are missing, disappearing, or unavailable in the app. One customer also cannot find videos from artists they follow.
code_definition: songs, artists, podcasts, videos or languages missing, removed or unavailable

description: Customers report hearing the same songs repeatedly in mixes or shuffle, or getting suggested music and playlists they do not want. Some say recommendations do not match their preferences.
code_definition: recommendations, discovery, search, generated mixes, unwanted suggested songs

issue_name: Downloaded Content Disappears or Won’t Play
description: Customers say downloads disappear, are deleted, or become unavailable when they go offline. Some also report that downloaded content will not play or that they cannot find or use the download option.
code_definition: downloads fail, disappear or will not play offline

description: Customers express religious or national objections to the app and some say they avoid or uninstall it for those reasons.
code_definition: political, religious, ethical or boycott statements that are not about how the product works

description: Customers express broad dislike of the app and say it is bad or getting worse. Some mention having problems without specifying what they are.
code_definition: general praise or criticism with no specific feature

description: Customers leave brief, general complaints about errors, bugs, or the app not working well, while some comments are too unclear to identify a specific problem.
code_definition: meaningless, unrelated or unintelligible text

description: Customers report distorted, low, or variable sound quality, including weak bass and low volume. Some say audio is missing or want higher-resolution and Dolby Atmos sound.
code_definition: sound quality or volume problems

description: Customers report offline or network connection errors that prevent playback, including when they say they have internet access. Some also describe trouble casting or controlling playback on another device.
code_definition: 'no internet connection' errors, or playback via bluetooth, car, cast, speaker, watch, another device or a voice assistant

issue_name: App Crashes or Fails to Open
description: Customers say the app crashes when they try to play music or does not open, sometimes showing only a black screen. Some also report repeated crashes or general app glitches.
code_definition: app crashes, freezes, will not open or is stuck loading

description: Customers report long waits for playback, search, and playlists to load, along with general slowness or lag. One customer says the app is slow when using mobile data, and another reports that it corrupted microSD cards.
code_definition: lag, slowness, battery, storage or mobile-data use

description: Customers say songs stop or pause during playback, sometimes after only a short time. Some also report songs skipping or not starting automatically.
code_definition: music or podcasts will not play, stop, pause, buffer, skip or restart by themselves

description: Customers say it is hard to contact support, and that responses can be rude, unhelpful, or fail to resolve their questions and issues.
code_definition: contacting customer support and the response received

description: Customers report that ads are annoying, appear too often, or interrupt playlists. One customer says the ads play in Hindi.
code_definition: too many, too long, too loud or badly timed ads

description: Customers report that playback can start unexpectedly or play a different song than the one selected, and that shuffle, playlist playback, and queue controls do not behave as expected. One customer says they cannot play personal music folders on their phone.
code_definition: shuffle, skip, repeat, queue, playlist editing, autoplay or voice controls that work badly, NOT described as a Premium-only restriction

description: Customers report that updates make the app worse or unusable, that screen tiles take up too much space, and that controls such as shuffle and repeat are hidden. Some also report being unable to turn off notifications or find Spotify Wrapped.
code_definition: layout, navigation, redesigns, home screen, notifications, widgets, removed interface features
